proposals.title: Item 4 – Shareholder Proposal – Make Shareholder Proxy Access More Accessible
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board reduce the shareholder aggregation threshold for proxy access by allowing shareholder groups to aggregate to 3% of stock held three years, removing the 20-shareholder nominating group limit.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal, which is identified as Item 4 on the proxy card

proposals.title: Item 5 – Shareholder Proposal – Amend Certificate of Incorporation to Become a Delaware Public Benefit Corporation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board amend the certificate of incorporation to convert Wells Fargo to a Delaware Public Benefit Corporation balancing shareholder and stakeholder interests and submit it to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal, which is identified as Item 5 on the proxy card

proposals.title: Item 6 – Shareholder Proposal – Report on Incentive-Based Compensation and Risks of Material Losses
proposals.proponent: Thomas P. DiNapoli, Comptroller of the State of New York
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether and how the company identifies employees eligible for incentive pay tied to metrics that could expose it to material losses, with methodology and breakdowns.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal, which is identified as Item 6 on the proxy card

proposals.title: Item 7 – Shareholder Proposal – Conduct a Racial Equity Audit
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the board to oversee a racial equity audit analyzing Wells Fargo's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, publicly disclosed on its website.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal, which is identified as Item 7 on the proxy card
